title: Add eval playbook runner and explanation-weighted scorer with graded holdback CI gate
author: Maya Lopez
description: Context: We need better signal and actionable guidance when eval regressions surface in CI. Small numeric drops are noisy; engineers want contextualized explanations and a controlled way to hold back changes for investigation. This PR introduces two pieces: (1) an 'Eval Playbook' runner that codifies probes, prioritized replay rules, and remediation steps; (2) an explanation-weighted scorer (ExplainerScorer) that synthesizes attribution traces and per-prompt diagnostics into a single regression score. Motivation: Reduce alert fatigue and shorten time-to-fix by pairing a graded CI gate with concrete repair steps. Summary of changes: - Add playbook runner (playbooks/runner.py) with YAML-based playbook format and a CLI for local replay. - Add explainer scorer (scorers/explainer_scorer.py) which combines token-attribution saliency, semantic drift, and response-coverage heuristics into a weighted score. - Add CI hook graded_holdback (ci/hooks/graded_holdback.py) which maps scorer outputs to a staged holdback decision: pass / warn / hold. - Add docs and examples (docs/eval-playbook.md, examples/playbooks/sample_repair.yml). - Tests and smoke harness (tests/test_playbook_runner.py, tests/test_explainer_scorer.py). Migration notes: - Playbooks are opt-in; no existing CI flows change by default. - A sample playbook is provided to start; teams should tune thresholds. Release notes: see release_notes field below. Checklist: - [x] Design review completed with Platform and SRE (ENG-8421) - [x] Unit tests added and passing - [x] End-to-end smoke run against small prompt set - [x] Docs added and linked from eval-harness README - [x] Backwards-compatible by default Links: Linear: ENG-8421, ENG-8493; Support ticket SUP-1192.
commits: 2 commits: 1) Add initial EvalPlaybook runner, sample playbook and CLI; 2) Add ExplainerScorer, CI graded holdback adapter, tests and docs; commit messages include short rationale and reference to ENG-8421.

release_notes: Introduce Eval Playbook runner and explanation-weighted scoring. Adds a graded CI holdback gate that surfaces per-prompt diagnostic explanations and maps them to pass/warn/hold actions. Playbooks are opt-in; see docs/eval-playbook.md and examples/playbooks/sample_repair.yml for onboarding steps.
notes_for_ops: Default thresholds are conservative; teams should evaluate hold rates on a shadow run for 2 weeks before turning 'hold' action to block merges. The scorer emits a per-run JSON debug artifact (s3 path printed in CI logs) used by auto-triage tooling.
